title: local-agent-lab as CAFE A3 — the Azure target it claims parity with (status per component)
use_case: CLAUDE.md Service Mapping: every local component stands in for a named Azure service. This renders that claim in CAFE vocabulary. Status is carried in each description because the CAFE spec has no per-component fill — GREEN = deployed and exercised, AMBER = built with a named limitation, GREY = not built (verified absent).

decision_points: Every LLM, tool and A2A call crosses ONE gateway — never point-to-point (G02/G04)
Destructive and repository writes require a human approval (G09) — the gate is a governed tool, not a UI
A workload holds NO store credentials: inputs arrive as art:// refs read through storage-mcp
The vendor transcribes; OUR model writes the minutes — summarisation is kept out of the speech port by design
GREY on this diagram is verified absent, not merely unfinished: Presidio, the EA port and the eval harness have no code
